_note: Single source of truth for Line of Command V1 balance numbers. spec.md quotes these values; if they disagree, this file wins and spec.md is the bug.
status: v1.1 addition 2026-11-22 (captain): the 3 daily ranked battles are offered as assignments from the war general on a campaign map. Solo vs NPC in V1. Changes no balance value.

seed.rng: PCG32, the same generator as the battle RNG

board.generated_at: built once per day, the first time the player opens the board after that day's 00:00 UTC reset, from the roster as it stands at that moment (the snapshot); then frozen for the day

frozen.rule: once built, the board never regenerates that day; later roster changes (breeding, release, promotion) do not change it
frozen.same_inputs_same_board: same scope_id + day_index + snapshot ranks always gives the same board
frozen.after_snapshot: options stay on the board if an officer on the snapshot is released or promoted; eligibility is checked at pick time against the picking officer's current rank (rank_eligibility)
frozen.manipulation: changing the roster before opening the board only changes which ranks are covered; board outcomes give no extra rewards, so nothing is gained

board.rank_eligibility: an officer may take an option of their own rank or one rank below (officer rank order - option rank order in {0, 1}); both armies use the option rank's point budget
board.scenario_rules: only if the player owns a Lieutenant or Captain; only at fort locations; at most one of each scenario per day; eligible officers = scenarios.<id>.open_to_ranks
steps: 2. required ranks: take the lowest owned rank r, add a standard option at r (it covers officers of rank r and r+1), remove r and r+1, repeat until every owned rank is covered (at most 3 options)
3. scenarios: if eligible, draw the count from scenario_count_weights (capped by free slots and fort count); if 2, one of each type, else draw the type by scenario_type_weights
4. fill the remaining slots with standard options at a rank drawn uniformly from the owned ranks
5. locations: scenario options draw distinct fort locations; standard options draw distinct unused locations uniformly
6. variety: while fewer than 3 distinct terrains, move the last not-yet-moved standard option to an unused location of a missing terrain
7. order: sort by rank order, scenarios last; option_id = '<day_index>-<slot>'
8. brief: narration.json briefing template, variant = hash(seed, slot) mod count

option_fields.rank: ranks.json id (scenarios: lieutenant, open to scenarios.<id>.open_to_ranks)

picking.per_officer_cap_status: DECIDED 2026-11-22 (captain): one officer may take all 3 daily battles; the account cap stays 3 (economy.daily_limits)
picking.unused_options: expire at the next 00:00 UTC reset; nothing banks
picking.opponent: existing ranked-opponent generator (ranks.rules.opponent, battle.ai_general) at the option's point budget

outcome.personal_map: a win flips the location's flag to the player's side in the player's own campaign view; a loss shows the enemy flag; nothing else changes
outcome.narration: battle_start and battle_end lines name the location (narration.json location_* templates)

shared_war_hooks.contributions_log: each finished assignment appends {war_id|null, day_index, option_id, location_id, side, officer_id, rank, result, reason, ticks, final strengths} to the account's contributions log in V1 (read-only); a shared war would aggregate it per location
shared_war_hooks.npc_fill_in: fill_npc(side, rank, seed) returns an officer and army from the existing opponent generator; V1 already uses it for every opponent
not_in_v1: front-line movement or control changes from results
